CheckRuns.description:
A snapshot of a pull request head's check runs: the first time a poll finds any, or none past
the 5-minute grace period.

base_branch.description: The branch the pull request merges into.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

head_branch.description: The head branch; null when GitHub no longer returns the pull request.

head_repo.description:
The head branch's repository, `owner/name`, which differs from `repo` for a fork; absent
when the event does not say, as for a check run or a deleted fork.

head_sha.description: The head commit; for a check, the commit it ran on.

runs.description: How many check runs the head had at the poll.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

updated_at.description: When GitHub last updated the pull request, before the poll.

url.description: The pull request's page; the review's for a review, the check run's for a check.

description:
A snapshot of a pull request head's check runs: the first time a poll finds any, or none past

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: github.pull_request.check_runs
